name: Volume Encryption at Rest (T1005, internal ref CSCRF-DP-01)
blast_radius: Read-only query of BitLocker status on the system volume.

name: Data Path ACL Exposure (T1083, internal ref CSCRF-DP-02)
blast_radius: Read-only ACL read of the path named by BAS_DP_PATH; skipped when unset.

name: SMB Encryption and SMB1 State (T1040, internal ref CSCRF-DP-03)
blast_radius: Read-only query of SMB server encryption and SMB1 protocol state.

name: DLP Agent Service Presence (T1562.001, internal ref CSCRF-DP-04)
blast_radius: Read-only service lookup for the name in BAS_DLP_SERVICE; skipped when unset.

name: Synthetic Marker Egress to Named Share (T1048, internal ref CSCRF-DP-05)
blast_radius: Writes one synthetic marker file (no real data) to BAS_DP_SHARE, reads it back, and deletes it in undo. Requires BAS_CONFIRM_DP_TEST=true.
